parent_status: V_rec protocol FROZEN at S7.2; gate evaluation DEFERRED_TO_S7.10
mandatory_failure_meaning: if a mandatory gate fails, Q_rec may NOT be presented as a successful structural-transfer result

gates.name: information boundary
gates.authoritative_definition: no target leakage; no admitted quantity with unresolved target ancestry in the primary boundary
gates.stage_owner: S7.3 established the boundary; final gate table at S7.12
gates.status_detail: auditable now from lineage; the final gate table is produced downstream
gates.evidence_required: S7.3 information-boundary artifacts and the leakage matrix, carried unchanged
gates.failure_meaning: MANDATORY: a failure prevents presenting Q_rec as a successful structural-transfer result

gates.name: development-only discovery
gates.authoritative_definition: target, ontology, support, estimator and thresholds chosen without external outcomes
gates.status_detail: auditable now and provisionally satisfied; it remains provisional until the S7.9 freeze fixes the support and estimator
gates.evidence_required: access audits showing zero external signal and target values through S7.9, plus the S7.9 hash record
gates.failure_meaning: MANDATORY: a failure prevents the structural-transfer claim

gates.name: nontrivial skill vs B0/B1
gates.authoritative_definition: Delta_j = mean over EXTERNAL discharges of (NRMSE_REL,s - NRMSE_Bj,s), with NRMSE_,s = mean over blocks A,B,C; PASS iff Delta_0 <= -0.01 AND Delta_1 <= -0.01
authoritative_corrections: S7.2C C-06 supplied the missing aggregate definition; the V1 wording 'predeclared aggregate sense' was not decidable
gates.status_detail: NOT evaluated in S7.8; requires the external cohort
gates.evidence_required: external protected scoring of the frozen representation and of B0 and B1 on identical samples
gates.failure_meaning: MANDATORY: this is the gate the retired q_rec failed

gates.name: fair raw comparison vs B2/B3
gates.authoritative_definition: fair comparison against B2 and B3 on identical information and geometry
gates.evidence_required: identical calibration intervals, identical protected samples, identical estimator discipline for B2 and B3
gates.failure_meaning: MANDATORY, but requires FAIRNESS not victory: the gate passes if the comparison was conducted properly, whatever the outcome

gates.name: external structural transfer
gates.authoritative_definition: support frozen and hashed before any external evaluation
gates.stage_owner: S7.10, conditioned on the S7.9 freeze
gates.status_detail: NOT evaluated until S7.10; the precondition is created by the S7.9 hash
gates.evidence_required: the S7.9 freeze hash predating the first external access timestamp
gates.failure_meaning: MANDATORY: without it the local-calibration design makes the claim vacuous

gates.name: processing-era robustness
gates.authoritative_definition: external results reported separately for the 24 earlier and 18 later external discharges; outcomes PASS / PASS_WITH_QUALIFICATION / FAIL_FOR_FULL_DOMAIN
authoritative_corrections: S7.2C C-07: external counts are 24 earlier / 18 later
the V1 wording 35 earlier / 27 later is SUPERSEDED_FOR_V6_BY_S7.2C_C07; those are PARENT OBJECT counts, not the external cohort the gate operates on
gates.failure_meaning: MANDATORY; FAIL_FOR_FULL_DOMAIN does not erase the result but narrows Omega_rec rather than averaging across the processing discontinuity

gates.name: common support
gates.authoritative_definition: cross-representation comparisons use identical scored samples
gates.stage_owner: protocol check S7.8; empirical comparison S7.10
gates.status_detail: the protocol requirement is verified now; the empirical common-support check belongs with the comparison
gates.evidence_required: identical protected sample sets across the representation and all four baselines
gates.failure_meaning: MANDATORY: unequal scored samples invalidate every paired comparison

gates.name: discharge-level inference
gates.authoritative_definition: discharge, not time sample, is the independent unit
gates.status_detail: every S7.8 quantity aggregates to the discharge before any standard error is taken; SE_delta uses n = 20 discharges
gates.evidence_required: paired discharge-level differences and discharge bootstrap in all inference
gates.failure_meaning: MANDATORY: sample-level inference would overstate precision by orders of magnitude

gates.name: sensitivity
gates.authoritative_definition: no result depends catastrophically on one discharge, one temporal block, or one numerical realization
gates.status_detail: NON-MANDATORY; a single influential discharge is a finding to report rather than a disqualification, provided it is reported
gates.failure_meaning: NON-MANDATORY: reported, does not block the claim

gates.name: numerical provenance
gates.authoritative_definition: no claim rests on interpolation-created resolution without qualification
gates.stage_owner: lineage auditable S7.8; final qualification downstream
gates.status_detail: S7.3R source-resolution reconciliation is carried unchanged; the final qualification statement belongs with the result
gates.evidence_required: the S7.3R/S7.4 V2 source-cadence and numerical-admissibility record
gates.failure_meaning: MANDATORY: a claim resting on interpolated resolution must be qualified or withdrawn

B0.definition: calibration mean predicted throughout the protected block

B1.definition: persistence: last calibration sample of the block held constant

B2.definition: raw ridge linear regression on target-admissible primitive predictors

baseline_notes.V3_requires: actual skill versus B0 and B1
baseline_notes.V4_requires: FAIR comparison with B2 and B3; V4 does NOT require beating B2/B3
baseline_notes.S_pers: remains required reporting but does NOT guide S7.9 selection

domain_reading: every quantity defined here is evaluated over the frozen explored frontier Ahat_rec only; A_rec minus Ahat_rec remains ADMISSIBLE_UNSEARCHED and carries no negative finding
